name: @symbo.ls/workspace-project-supabase
description: Workspace-project Supabase-backed surface for @symbo.ls/sdk — the curated /workspace-project/* REST wrapper + PostgREST passthrough adapter for tenant tables that haven't been migrated to Mongo yet. WorkspaceProjectService + supabasePassthrough live here so the SDK core stays Mongo-only.

scripts.build:types: tsc -p tsconfig.json || echo '::warning::tsc exited non-zero — type declarations may be incomplete (publish proceeds; fix as separate work)'
scripts.build: rimraf dist && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types
